notes.title: Knight of the Dungeon Demo is out
notes.notes:
[p]Today we can finally present a demo version of the game about the adventures of a knight in a Dungeon. [/p][p][/p][h3]In the demo you will find:[/h3][list][*][p]2 levels filled with crowds of mobs[/p][/*][*][p]Many different weapons with unique mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]Various NPCs that you can trade with[/p][/*][*][p]2 bosses at the end of the levels[/p][/*][/list][h2]Dungeon Level:[/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609576/4cb68bf3eb46447615f8a82c2ffc2e653bdd813e.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Jungle Level:[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45609576/4fd1c9e93b0487619478407a1eb615faf8a36a41.jpg"][/img]
The full version of the game will be released in the [b]summer of 2025[/b]. Add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] and see you soon.[/p]
